Ever find yourself wondering what it really means to live a fulfilling life? Even when we’re busy chasing goals and checking off to-dos, those deeper questions about meaning and success can quietly shape the way we make choices every day. In a world that seems to celebrate nonstop achievement, it’s easy to feel like a true sense of purpose is just out of reach.
That’s where the wisdom of Clayton M. Christensen comes in, through his thought-provoking book, How Will You Measure Your Life? He invites us to pause for a moment, look beyond the headlines of success, and really reflect on what matters most. By blending insights from business, personal relationships, and the pursuit of happiness, he helps us see that the journey to a well-lived life isn’t always straightforward—but it is absolutely worth exploring.
Together, we’ll look at how to align our values with our actions, and balance ambition with integrity. We’ll discover how to find satisfaction not just in what we accomplish, but in the strength of our character and the quality of our connections with others. So, as we set out on this journey, let’s open ourselves up to practical wisdom, gentle challenges, and new ways of thinking—so we can build a life that feels both meaningful and truly our own. Let’s dive in, together.
